about: Written by tests/dialogue_cpu/paging_cases.cpp from tests/data/dialogue-paging-inputs.json. Offsets are UTF-16 code units. clusters are grapheme ends, advances each grapheme's width in its paragraph, legal the ICU strict line breaks, line_table the greedy line from every start the ranking may try: 0, legal breaks, forced starts and line ends (end includes a trailing newline; halved: the closing mark at the end takes half width). The ranking picks page ends from these; expected is what the game lays out.

cases.name: 25405 zh-Hans 13
cases.text: “唔……这里是……敌人！？是敌人……这个敌人，要把天空击落。”

cases.name: 25405 en 13
cases.text: “Ngh... this place... is the enemy?! The enemy... this enemy will bring down the sky.”

cases.name: 19552 zh-Hans 13
cases.text: “我是迪奥，迪奥·麦斯威尔。虽然会逃会躲，但绝不说谎迪奥·麦斯威尔”

cases.name: 19552 en 13
cases.text: “I'm Duo, Duo Maxwell. I may run and hide, but I never tell a lie. Duo Maxwell.”

cases.name: 22811 zh-Hans 13
cases.text: “没错，就是这个男人。肖特也是个讨厌的家伙，但这个男人的眼神让我很在意，所以只有这点我记得很清楚。沙罗为什么会有照片？”

cases.name: 22811 en 13
cases.text: “That's right, this is the man. Shot was unpleasant too, but this man's eyes bothered me, so that much I remember clearly. Why do you have his photo, Sara?”

cases.name: 23108 zh-Hans 13
cases.text: “那也无所谓。只是不把话说清楚，我心里不痛快。明明问题一大堆，同伴之间还闹别扭，总觉得不太好吧。”

cases.name: 23108 en 13
cases.text: “That's fine with me. I just couldn't rest easy unless I said it properly. We've got plenty of problems as it is, and things being awkward between comrades isn't good, is it?”

cases.name: 24093 zh-Hans 13
cases.text: “才、才不是那样！只是嘛，要是被敌人的子弹打中死掉也就罢了，可要是宇航服破了个洞，空气漏光死掉什么的……不是很讨厌吗。比如睡着的时候舰里的空气没了之类的……”

cases.name: 24093 en 13
cases.text: “I-it's not like that! It's just, dying from enemy fire is one thing, but a hole in your suit and then you run out of air and die... I don't want that. Like the ship running out of air while you're asleep...”

cases.name: 25252 zh-Hans 13
cases.text: “阁下您太狡猾了。阁下是必须站上世界顶点的人。可您却任由世界陷入混乱。我是为了辅佐阁下才上宇宙的。而且，我已经为阁下备好了未来。”

cases.name: 25252 en 13
cases.text: “You are unfair, Your Excellency. You are a man who must stand at the pinnacle of the world. Yet you leave the world in chaos. I went up to space to assist you, and I have prepared your future.”

cases.name: 23754 zh-Hans 13
cases.text: “第一次见到你时的我，连世界变成了什么样都不去想，自己什么代价都不付，只是一味享受着幸福，是个不谙世事的人。可是自从遇见你之后，我的命运就发生了巨大的改变。现在……我也在用我自己的方式战斗着。”

cases.name: 23754 en 13
cases.text: “When I first met you, I never even thought about what was happening in the world. I paid no price myself, and simply enjoyed my happiness— I was so naive. But after meeting you, my fate changed greatly. Now... I fight in my own way too.”

cases.name: 40584 zh-Hans 13
cases.text: “进入宇宙的旧格拉多斯人，已经逐渐迎来了作为物种的极限。4万年前，他们的宇宙船发现了这颗行星——地球。当时地球上，已经诞生了可称为原人类的生命。调查的结果，判断其作为物种与自己极为相近的旧格拉多斯人，为了延续这濒临灭绝的物种，做了一个尝试。将地球的原人类的生命核移植到自己体内，试图再次获得强大的生命力。”

cases.name: 40584 en 13
cases.text: “The ancestral Gradosians who had advanced into space were already approaching the limits of their species. Forty thousand years ago, their ships discovered this planet, Earth. At the time, life that could be called proto-humanity had been born on Earth. After investigation, the ancestral Gradosians judged that as a species it was extremely close to their own, and for the sake of preserving their dying species, they made one attempt. By transplanting the life-core of Earth's proto-humans into themselves, they sought to gain once more a strong life force.”

cases.name: 44787 zh-Hans 13
cases.text: “据我听说，婴儿时期的尊所乘坐的胶囊，本应该一直保持原样才对。是因为地壳变动，才让它冒了出来。这是其一。其二，是发现它的地球人，……也就是明神夫妇，教会了尊爱人之心、爱地球之心。其三，是尊的亲生父亲不惜违抗祖尔也要送出的五神机器人的存在。这三者哪怕缺了任何一个，装在盖亚上的反阳子炸弹都应该已经启动了。”

cases.name: 44787 en 13
cases.text: “From what I heard, the capsule baby Takeru was in was supposed to stay buried as it was. It was crustal movement that brought it out. That's one. The second is that the Earthlings who found it... in other words, the Myojin couple, taught Takeru to love people, to love the Earth. The third is that Takeru's real father sent in the Five God Robo even in defiance of Zuhl. If even one of those had been missing, the antiproton bomb set in Gaiya would have gone off.”

cases.name: 35024 zh-Hans 13
cases.text: “表面上如此。现在的问题是，接下来地球圈的主导权由谁来掌握。只要解决了这个，地球圈怎样都好办。若是财团，那就是古老传统与格式之类的时代了。随着时间逐渐形骸化，是不可避免的系统。若是贾米托夫的OZ，那就是军阀政治。纷争不断的世界。这样下去两边都不好。要治理今后时代的地球圈，需要新的天才，你不这么觉得吗？”

cases.name: 35024 en 13
cases.text: “On the surface, yes. The real question is who will hold control of the Earth Sphere after this. Once that's settled, the Earth Sphere can be shaped any way. Under the Foundation, it'd be an age of old traditions and prestige. A system that inevitably becomes an empty shell with time. Under Jamitov's OZ, it'd be military rule. A world of endless conflict. Neither is good. To govern the Earth Sphere in the coming era, a new genius is needed. Don't you think so?”

cases.name: 17387 zh-Hans 13
cases.text: “‘武机霸拳流’星野翔道谢就不必了，万丈大人”

cases.name: 17387 en 13
cases.text: “‘Buki Haken-ryu’, Kaito Hoshi. I won't bow to you, Lord Banjo or whatever you are.”
